Summary

  • I am a full-stack web developer with a robust skill set spanning Next.js, Prisma, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, ZenStack, Tailwind CSS, API development, and data analysis. I also have extensive experience with Python and R, particularly in handling complex data workflows and statistical modeling. My background as a postdoctoral researcher in experimental medical sciences has equipped me with a sharp analytical mindset, a deep understanding of data, and the ability to learn new technologies rapidly. This scientific training, combined with hands-on software engineering experience, allows me to approach development challenges with both creativity and precision. I am currently seeking consulting opportunities where I can leverage this unique combination of skills to build scalable, data-driven web applications.
